stage1.title: Hollowmere Village
lines: The village first. This is where the dead come thickest — they have the least ground to climb, and they know the streets as well as you do.
Hold the square. Somewhere out in the fog, the one who tends the graves has heard you, and is coming to put you back in yours.

stage2.title: The Wailing Forest
lines: Past the last house the Wailing Forest crowds down to the water. The trees here were buried once too, and they remember it.
Something with antlers moves between the trunks, and something older still rules from the briar. The forest does not want to be walked tonight.

stage3.title: Castle Vane
lines: The road climbs at last to Castle Vane, where the bell hangs and the bargain was struck.
Whatever the king let into the chapel is still there, and it has been waiting a long time to be met. This is where the night is decided — one way, or the other.

stage4.title: The Hollow Beneath
lines: Under Castle Vane the stairs go down further than any mason cut them. The dead here are the oldest dead — the first to be wronged, the first to refuse the grave.
This is where it began: the wound the whole night bleeds from. Go down. Find the thing that will not stay buried, and bury it for good.
